description: Bandizip - all-in-one compression tool (v6.18 - last ad-free version, portable)
post_install: $c = Join-Path $dir 'config.ini'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c) { $t = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath $c; if ($t -match '(?m)^default_language\s*=\s*$') { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($c, ($t -replace '(?m)^(default_language\s*=\s*)$', '${1}SimpChinese'), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) } }

foreach ($e in $exts) { $p = 'Bandizip.' + $e; $prog = $classes + '\' + $p; New-Item -Force -Path $prog | Out-Null; Set-Item -Path $prog -Value 'Bandizip 压缩文件'; $ico = $dir + '\icons\default\' + $e + '.ico'; if (-not (Test-Path $ico)) { $ico = $exe }; New-Item -Force -Path ($prog + '\DefaultIcon') | Out-Null; Set-Item -Path ($prog + '\DefaultIcon') -Value ('"' + $ico + '",0'); New-Item -Force -Path ($prog + '\shell\open\command') | Out-Null; Set-Item -Path ($prog + '\shell\open\command') -Value ('"' + $exe + '" "%1"'); $k = $classes + '\.' + $e; New-Item -Force -Path $k | Out-Null; Set-Item -Path $k -Value $p; New-Item -Force -Path ($k + '\OpenWithProgids') | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path ($k + '\OpenWithProgids') -Name $p -Value '' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null }

$cap = 'HKCU:\Software\Bandizip\Capabilities'; New-Item -Force -Path ($cap + '\FileAssociations') | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cap -Name ApplicationName -Value 'Bandizip'; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cap -Name ApplicationDescription -Value 'Bandizip 压缩文件管理器'; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cap -Name ApplicationIcon -Value ('"' + $exe + '",0'); foreach ($e in $exts) { Set-ItemProperty -Path ($cap + '\FileAssociations') -Name ('.' + $e) -Value ('Bandizip.' + $e) }

try { Add-Type -Namespace Win -Name Shell -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("shell32.dll")] public static extern void SHChangeNotify(int eventId, uint flags, System.IntPtr item1, System.IntPtr item2);' -ErrorAction Stop; [Win.Shell]::SHChangeNotify(0x08000000, 0, [System.IntPtr]::Zero, [System.IntPtr]::Zero) } catch {}
pre_uninstall: if ((Get-ItemProperty -Path $hk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).'(default)' -like "$dir\*") { reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\CLSID\$id" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\WOW6432Node\CLSID\$id" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\*\ShellEx\ContextMenuHandlers\AABdzCtx" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\ShellEx\ContextMenuHandlers\AABdzCtx" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\Background\ShellEx\ContextMenuHandlers\AABdzCtx" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Drive\ShellEx\ContextMenuHandlers\AABdzCtx" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\ShellEx\DragDropHandlers\AABdzCtx" /f 2>$null | Out-Null; reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Drive\ShellEx\DragDropHandlers\AABdzCtx" /f 2>$null | Out-Null }

$capicon = (Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Bandizip\Capabilities' -Name ApplicationIcon -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ApplicationIcon; if ($capicon -like ('*' + $dir + '*')) { $exts = @('zip','zipx','7z','rar','tar','gz','tgz','bz2','tbz','tbz2','xz','txz','lzh','lha','alz','egg','cab'); foreach ($e in $exts) { $p = 'Bandizip.' + $e; Remove-Item -Path ('HKCU:\Software\Classes\' + $p) -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $k = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\.' + $e; if ((Get-ItemProperty -Path $k -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).'(default)' -eq $p) { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '(default)' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Remove-ItemProperty -Path ($k + '\OpenWithProgids') -Name $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Remove-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Bandizip\Capabilities' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\RegisteredApplications' -Name 'Bandizip' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir) { try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $persist_dir | Out-Null; Move-Item -LiteralPath $dir -Destination ($persist_dir + '\bandizip6.busy-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
notes: 自托管便携版：由已安装的 6.18 (Build 26084) 目录打包，config.ini 已设为 is_portable=1，无需手动安装。
右键菜单：安装时对 bdzshl64/32.dll 执行 regsvr32（写入 HKCU），再把注册项同步到 HKLM。UAC 关闭（Explorer 提权运行）时只认 HKLM，所以 HKLM 这步是必需的；普通用户环境 HKCU 亦可生效。
HKLM 注册为全机器范围（需管理员权限，失败不影响安装）：同一台电脑的其他 Windows 用户也会看到该右键菜单，且指向本机 scoop 安装目录。
首次安装会把 config.ini 的空 default_language 设为 SimpChinese（若你已自行设置则不覆盖）。
Windows 11 的旧式右键扩展折叠在右键 →“显示更多选项”（Shift+F10）中。

文件关联：安装时把常用压缩格式（zip/zipx/7z/rar/tar/gz/tgz/bz2/tbz/tbz2/xz/txz/lzh/lha/alz/egg/cab）以 ProgID Bandizip.<ext> 关联到本程序，并注册到 HKCU Capabilities；卸载时清理。注意 Win10/11 对默认关联有保护，若某格式已有 UserChoice 可能仍沿用原程序，可在“打开方式”或默认应用里改选 Bandizip。
卸载时若目录被 Explorer 加载的 DLL 锁住无法删除，会移动到 persist andizip6.busy-<时间戳>；下次安装的 pre_install 会自动清理该目录（Explorer 重启/重启系统后锁已释放）。
卸载时会重启资源管理器以释放被加载 DLL 的文件锁（已打开的文件夹窗口会关闭），随后直接删除安装目录，并清理遗留的 bandizip6.busy-*。
